description: This Java class creates an Akka actor for streaming persisted connection data. It defines methods to generate actor properties, and create connection tags and process entity IDs with revisions for persistence.

classes.name: ConnectionPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: Creates an Akka actor that streams information about persisted connection entities.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props object for the persistence streaming actor with specified cache size.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionTag from a PidWithSeqNr object by extracting the connection ID and sequence number.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Creates a PidWithSeqNr object from an EntityIdWithRevision by constructing the persistence ID and including the revision.
